relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a girl with early-onset sarcoidosis in whom 'genetic testing revealed a novel mutation of unknown significance in the NOD2 gene'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; output assembled with a short Python script from hand-chosen values. No tables. The NOD2 variant is not described (no cDNA or protein string printed), so the variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported'. Year taken from the copyright line ('Copyright © 2023'), the only year printed. Age at onset not stated as an age (only 'a 6 month worsening history' before diagnosis at 4 years), so left not reported. 'Chest X-ray was normal' is a whole-investigation normal result; recorded as 'abnormal chest X-ray' excluded and not used to exclude interstitial lung disease. Possible tension: 'She had reported no recent visual problems' (patient-reported symptoms) vs examination finding of 'reduced visual acuity in both eyes'; treated as different features (symptom report vs measured acuity), so visual impairment kept observed in the checklist. 'Red eyes' was not mapped to uveitis on its own; uveitis is observed from 'Arthritis and uveitis were confirmed on admission'. The mother is mentioned only as giving consent and parents as giving injections; no relatives were given rows. Vital status not stated.
